newsitem.title: USA: Clinton calls on Congress to work with him.
newsitem.headline: Clinton calls on Congress to work with him.

text.p: President Clinton on Monday called on the Republican-led Congress to work with him to solve the country's problems and fullfill its promise.

Declaring that the U.S. economy was the strongest and most productive in the world, Clinton urged the lawmakers to set aside "petty bickering and extreme partisanship" to help develop a "new government" for the next century.
"We need a new government for a new century, ... a government that is smaller, lives within its means and does more with less," he said in his inaugural speech for his second term.
"Our Land of New Promise will be a nation that meets its obligations, a nation that balances its budget and never loses the balance of its values," Clinton continued.
"A nation where grandparents have secure retirement and health care, and their granchildren know we have made the reforms necessary to sustain the benefits for their time," he added.
